as_told.title: T. Townsend Brown had visitors land in Zanesville

plain: Small beings are said to have landed in the yard of Thomas Townsend Brown, an American inventor who studied links between electricity and gravity, got out, and given him information. Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he has had his own UFO encounters, tells this as something he was told by a man named Timothy Taylor. Bledsoe says that when they reached Zanesville together, Taylor revealed who he was and that he was helping Brown's daughter finish a book about her father. From Taylor, Bledsoe says, he learned the story of Brown "having visitors come and land." Michels adds another source: Brown's daughter, Linda Brown, did an online question-and-answer session on Reddit, a discussion website. In it, Michels says, she spoke of pale beings coming down and entering the house, into the kitchen. If true, it would mean an inventor of gravity-related devices had been in contact with visitors.
